summary: Tests-writing phase for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). Committed: (1) permanent contract tests guarding the to-be-vendored OpenAPI document (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/OpenAPIDocumentContractTests.swift) - compiles today against the existing test target and fails red via assertions until the spec is vendored at iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-openapi.json; (2) generated-client tests against stubbed URLProtocol responses (iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingOpenAPITests/OpenAPIClientTests.swift) - inert until the implementation run declares the ColorMatchingOpenAPITests target and generates the ColorMatchingOpenAPI module per docs/ios-openapi-generated-client.md; (3) LID doc recording the contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec derived from viamin/color_matching main (api_schemas.ex, api_spec.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, capture_controller.ex, 2026-11-02): measurement/judgment uploads return 200 + counted JSON (not 204), measurement stats and top-level scoring_algorithm_version are absent from the published request schema, normalized_linear_rgb_median is required, manifest omits patches/pairs/page/registration_markers/manifest_url, white_balance_gains is opaque, capture create accepts a flat anyOf variant with exposure_duration/rejection_reasons naming, ranked results gained schema_version lps-ranked-results/v1. Environment limits: no Swift toolchain in this container (swift: command not found), so swift test could not be executed here; no live server (by design - all new tests use stubbed responses). Package.swift/target/deps changes are blocked for this phase by the tests-only commit rules and are specified in the LID doc for the implementation run.
